description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a client interacting with request/response APIs in the Eclipse Hono project, including cache size and timeout settings.

classes.name: RequestResponseClientConfigProperties
classes.description: A class extending ClientConfigProperties that manages cache size and timeout settings for request/response client configuration.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMinSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum size of the response cache.

methods.name: getResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the response cache.

methods.name: setResponseCacheMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the response cache.

methods.name: getResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout for cached responses.

methods.name: setResponseCacheDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout in seconds for cached responses.
